The mathematical nonsplitting follows because each integral rank-one rational summand reduces to an r-fixed line and every rank-two E lattice has at least one F2 rotation fixed vector, contradicting observed two fixed dimensions. Nonstandard computations are verified directly from the packaged verify.py.

originality.rationale: Full text of the 2026 primary paper gives nonequivariant integral Betti numbers and small-width homotopy types, not square-quarter-turn binary homology. Published published-finding corpus matching-complex calculations cover orthogonal reflections and 180-degree half-turns, and existing D4 grid results refer to different complexes. The new 90-degree action, four-step F2 Jordan block and integral non-splitting implication were not covered by inspected implications; aliases and stronger-result searches were performed. Unindexed equivalent work remains a genuine residual risk.
residual_risks: Equivalent unpublished or unindexed computations may exist despite checked literature and finding-database searches.
Other group-theoretic descriptions of the same F2 module could obscure terminological search matches.

value.rationale: The 3-by-3 grid is the smallest width-three square possessing a genuine order-four rotation absent in generic rectangles. The computed length-four unipotent block is a specific non-routine integral symmetry invariant, not determined by the published n=3 Betti rank, the all-width reflection/half-turn traces, or the calculated rational character. The resulting four-constituent integral nonsplitting provides a mathematically motivated 2-primary representation obstruction for a canonical graph-topology test case.
